wiki.summary: Track seven is titled “BBW”, which is an acronym for ‘Big Beautiful Woman’, and is meant to be a loving term that is a form to display body positivity. Drake has actually talked about his preference for BBW’s before. In 2014, he featured on Nicki Minaji’s hit song “Only”, where he raps: "Yeah, that’s right, I like my girls BBW" Read more on Last.fm.
